competences.description: Attacks all enemies to block them from receiving beneficial effects for 2 turns.

Attacks all enemies 3 times. The first hit removes 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance, and the second and third hits block them from removing harmful effects for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Oblivion.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss attacks an enemy with no beneficial effects. When attacking enemies granted with Beneficial Effects Blocked, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
